text: Delta waves (0.1–4 Hz) are a hallmark of unconsciousness in both sleep and general anesthesia (GA). Closed-loop auditory stimulation (CLAS) delivers brief sounds phase-locked to ongoing slow oscillations and can modulate slow-wave activity (SWA) during sleep, but its efficacy and translational relevance under propofol anesthesia, particularly in the presence of nociceptive input, remain unknown.
source_label: Protocol for modulating anesthesia delta oscillations using closed loop auditory stimulation
